member.name: T:AOPC.Application.Common.Utils.ImageUrlHelper
member.summary:
Resolves a stored image path into the full URL every API response returns, and reverses that on the way back in on Save — so the two stay symmetric and the database only ever ends up storing a bare path (or an untouched legacy URL), never Uploads:PathUrl baked in permanently.
Without the reverse (StripPathUrl) direction, a Get/List response would hand back an absolute URL, the client would round-trip that same value back on the next Save untouched, and — since it already looks "absolute" — it would get written straight to the database. That reproduces the exact bug already fixed once for the legacy CDN URL (see BusinessService/BusinessTypeService/OfferingService/ PrivilegeService/MembershipService/UserService's ResolveImageUrl helpers), except this time with Uploads:PathUrl baked in — which breaks the moment PathUrl ever changes (dev/staging/prod split, moving the uploads host, etc.).

member.summary: Applied when building a Get/List response DTO. A legacy absolute URL (or null/empty) is returned unchanged; anything else — a bare path like "/uploads/business-types/guid.jpg" — is prefixed with pathUrl so every API consumer (mobile app included, not just the Blazor CMS) gets a directly loadable URL without needing its own resolution logic.

member.name: M:AOPC.Application.Common.Utils.ImageUrlHelper.StripPathUrl(System.String,System.String)
member.summary: Applied at the top of a Save method, before any of the per-service legacy-prefix handling runs. If the incoming value is exactly ResolveForResponse's own output round-tripped back unchanged (the common case: the client fetched a record, didn't touch its image, and saved it again), strips pathUrl back off so what gets persisted is the bare path — never pathUrl baked into the database.
